notes.description: In Take A, the cybernetic man asks the older man if he is ready and checks in with Barley, whereas in Take B, he repeatedly says 'Dom' and points out a target.
In Take A, the cybernetic man handles a microphone and a radio antenna, which are completely absent in Take B.
In Take A, the cybernetic man stands in a three-shot handing off items, whereas in Take B, he physically pulls the older man close by the shoulder.
